_comment: The official Claude Code LSP plugins (marketplace claude-plugins-official) and the language-server binary each one needs on PATH. Single source for init.sh/init.ps1 (--lsp=<plugin>) and for /init-project, which maps the detected language to a plugin. A plugin only provides the wiring: without its binary it stays inert ('Executable not found in $PATH' in /plugin > Errors). 'install' is a hint shown to the user, never run by the deploy.

clangd-lsp.install: apt install clangd  |  brew install llvm

jdtls-lsp.install: brew install jdtls  |  Eclipse JDT LS release archive on PATH

lua-lsp.install: brew install lua-language-server  |  release archive on PATH

pyright-lsp.install: npm install -g pyright  |  pipx install pyright

swift-lsp.install: ships with Xcode / the Swift toolchain
